integrity.graph: Petersen graph KG(5,2), all 1024 masks enumerated
integrity.proof: Complete acyclic face-poset matchings, an explicit unit-minor signed integral Morse boundary at \(r=4\), and a full augmented \(\mathbb F_2\) persistent boundary reduction.

scientific_limitations: The integral homotopy statement is for the ten-vertex Petersen graph at integer parameters 1 through 10 only. The reduced persistent barcode is over \(\mathbb F_2\); no equivariant classification or general-family assertion is made. Published earlier Petersen \(\operatorname{Ind}_2\) work is acknowledged and not presented as new.
title: Complete higher-independence homotopy and persistence of the Petersen graph
